insights.title: Errors start at InvoiceProcessor
insights.detail: 26 errors in the last 24 hours, affecting “Web requests to checkout” and “MonthlyClose runs”; it calls InvoicesTable, api.stripe.com. Most common in its logs: “Timeout calling https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices after <n> ms” (19 of 26 error lines).
insights.action: Start with that message: it is 73% of the error lines.

insights.title: checkout-orders-db saturates first
insights.detail: CPU peaked at 80%; it reaches its limit at 1.25× today's traffic. Everything that depends on it slows down or fails with it.
insights.action: Add a reader for read traffic, move to a larger instance class, or put a cache in front of hot queries.

insights.title: InvoicesTable is on 2 flows
insights.detail: DynamoDB table sits on the path of Web requests to checkout, MonthlyClose runs. A slowdown or outage there is felt by all of them.
insights.action: Give it alarms on latency and errors, and check the flows degrade gracefully when it is slow.

insights.title: checkout-order-events can be processed twice
insights.detail: Its visibility timeout is 30 s but InvoiceProcessor may run for 60 s. AWS recommends at least six times the function timeout (360 s).
insights.action: Raise the visibility timeout to 360 s or more.

insights.title: checkout-order-events has no dead-letter queue
insights.detail: Messages that keep failing are retried until they expire and then disappear without a trace.
insights.action: Add a redrive policy to a dead-letter queue and alarm on its depth.

insights.title: checkout-orders-db-dev is on 2 flows
insights.detail: Aurora / RDS cluster sits on the path of Work done by checkout-api (dev), report-generator runs (dev). A slowdown or outage there is felt by all of them, and it runs in a single availability zone.
insights.action: Give it alarms on latency and errors, and check the flows degrade gracefully when it is slow.
